title: Deactivating a sales rep with no customer assignments applies silently with no dialog
custom_preconds: 1. A ZZAUTOTEST staff member is active with the sales-rep toggle ON and NO customers assigned to them as sales rep.
custom_steps: 1. Edit the staff member in staff administration and toggle their active status off.
custom_expected: 1. The deactivation applies silently — no warning dialog is shown.
